Planned for later milestones. Not available yet.
Tutorial restarts at its entrance. Adventure gear and checkpoints stay separate.
1 Move & observe: reach the gold marker on the left with WASD, then aim toward the upper-left range.
2 Fire & cover: hit both gold targets in the upper-left. Walk around the wall to hit the covered target.
3 Dodge warnings: meet a slow bullet in the centre lane and dodge through it with Space. Retry safely if hit.
4 Gear: collect a coin below, take the shotgun with E and hit its target above. Fire until energy runs short, then press 1 for the pistol.
5 Items: take the medkit below with E and heal with Q. Then choose one of the two passive stations to the right and inspect the change.
6 Map & objective: open and close Tab map. Activate the upper-right beacon with E, then press E at the right-hand gate.
7 Final drill: defeat two guards and a low-damage elite on the right. After clearing them, press E at the exit.
Follow the gold marker. Esc pauses or exits. Retry resets this step only.
You can retry this step. Dodge-step skipping is now available, or skip the whole tutorial.
Step reset at a safe position. Resources restored.
Take and successfully use the medkit with Q before choosing a passive.
Passive applied: a shorter firing interval or 25 extra maximum health.
Open and close the Tab map before activating the beacon.
Beacon activated. Objective gate open; reach the exit and press E.

You've learned the basics. Tutorial equipment stays in this session.
Try the adventure prototype, explore the training grounds, or return to the menu.

Completion and skipped-step marks are separate · No personal best
Welcome to Starport Range! Press E near any cyan station, or use the equipment and controls buttons below.
Practice aids · Infinite energy {energy} · Infinite charges {charges} · Invincible {invincible}

DPS uses the last 10 seconds of effective game time, or time since reset when shorter. Pauses do not age samples.
The armored target reduces damage by 50%. Statistics use effective damage and reset on gear changes.
Upper-left range: static target on the left, moving target in the middle, armored target on the right. Close this panel to fire.

Upper-right lane: slow bullets, a warned charge strip, and ground hazards. Gold warns; orange deals damage.
The drill runs after closing the panel. Normal dodge and hit protection still apply.

Select 3, 6 or 12 guards, then a group to start manually. No endless spawning.
Starting replaces the previous group. Death returns you safely to camp.
Safely returned to camp. Old enemies, hazards and effects cleared.
This environment zone is reserved. Conveyors, ice and periodic grids will arrive with their campaign stages; they are not available in M2a.
Not implemented: crossbow/launcher/arc gun; slow field/shockwave/decoy/grenade; pierce/bounce/critical/kill-energy/low-health guard/blast/controlled bonus/flawless heal.
